title: Equality of Boolean Indicators
statement: Let $L$ be a language of bit strings, let $y$ be a bit string, and let $P$ be a decidable proposition. If $y$ belongs to $L$ exactly when $P$ holds, then the Boolean indicator of $L$ at $y$ equals the Boolean truth value of $P$.
